info.name: Finance API Training — LendFast Sandbox
info.description:
Hands-on collection for the **API Fundamentals for Finance** half-day course.

**Before you start:** import the *LendFast Sandbox* environment, select it in the top-right dropdown, and make sure the training API is running (`./run.sh` in the project folder).

Requests are numbered to match the Lab Workbook and the slide deck.

| Key | Who | Scope |
|---|---|---|
| demo-key-001 | Ava Nguyen | read — GET only |
| demo-key-002 | Ben Fischer | write — GET, POST, PATCH |
| demo-key-003 | Service Account | read |

Client secret for `/oauth/token`: `training-secret`.

Nothing here touches real customer data or real money.

request.description: Is the service running? Do this first, every time. Try renaming the path to /healt to see a 404, then stop the server and send again to see a connection error.

Your first authenticated call. After it lands, look at the Headers tab in the response: X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-Request-Id and X-Environment. Then disable the X-API-Key header and send again for a 401.

item.name: 5.6c  OAuth2 client credentials — get a token

request.description:
The formal, production-grade version of an API key. The reply carries an access_token with an expiry, which then travels as Authorization: Bearer <token>.

This request takes client_id and client_secret from the environment ({{writeKey}} and {{clientSecret}}), so it keeps working when a cohort uses its own keys.
